description: Create a draft invoice by hand. It stays a draft: finalizing and sending happen in the app, and finalizing needs a real sender address with a tax number or VAT ID (billingEntityId from list_billing_entities, or create_billing_entity with data the user gives you, never invented). Example: invoiceDate "2026-11-04", billingClientId from list_billing_clients, lineItems [{position: 1, description: "Consulting", quantity: 8, unit: "h", unitPrice: 95, vatRate: 19}].

billingEntityId.description: Sender, from list_billing_entities. Left out, the company settings are the sender, not the default entity

name: create_invoice
title: Create draft invoice
